section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Axle Hub
title: ASSEMBLY OF FRONT AXLE HUB

content.description: Illustration showing MP Grease being applied to a bearing

items: (a) Place MP grease in the palm of your hand.
(b) Pack grease into the bearing, continuing until the grease oozes out from the other side.
(c) Do the same around the bearing circumference.

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing MP Grease application to hub cap and inner/outer bearings

content.text: 2. COAT INSIDE OF HUB AND CAP WITH MP GREASE

content.description: Illustration showing installation of inner bearing and oil seal using SST tool

content.text: 3. INSTALL INNER BEARING AND OIL SEAL
Place inner bearing into the hub. Using SST, drive the oil seal into the hub. Coat the oil seal with MP grease.

items: (a) Place the axle hub on the spindle.
(b) Install the outer bearing and thrust washer.

content.description: Illustration showing torque wrench adjusting nut on hub assembly

items: (b) Turn the hub right and left two or three times to allow the bearings to settle.
(c) Loosen the nut so there is 0.5 — 1.0 mm (0.020 — 0.039 in.) play in the hub axial direction.

content.description: Illustration showing spring tension gauge measuring rotation friction force on wheel hub assembly

items: (d) Using a spring tension gauge, measure the rotation friction force of the oil seal.
(e) Using a socket in your hand, tighten the nut as tight as possible.

content.text: In addition to rotation friction force of the oil seal 0 — 1,050 g (0 — 2.3 lb, 0 — 10 N)
